notes: The catalog titles the program 'Mobile Food Operations'; the state file title is 'Mobile Food Truck Operations'. The award table header at the top of page 170 is cut off ('Operations T045670D C 17').

The printed course units sum to 18 (2+4+6+3+3), but the catalog states 'Major Units: 17' and '17 units of Required Courses'. BUS 001 is printed at 4 units, while the state file stores BUS 1 at 3 units. With 3 units for BUS the sum would be 17. A reviewer should check this.
BUS 001, MGMT 013 and MARKET 001 are printed with leading zeros. They were matched to the closed-list codes BUS 1, MGMT 13 and MARKET 1.
Required courses are printed under SEMESTER I (CLN ART 112, BUS 001, CLN ART 180) and SEMESTER II (MGMT 013, MARKET 001). All are required, so they are recorded as one block.
The PLO lead-in says 'Upon completion of the Degree program', but these outcomes are printed in the certificate's section. The first outcome is printed with a double period, kept as printed.
The overview calls the award 'Certificate in Achievement'; the section heading says 'Certificate of Achievement'.
No careers or job titles are named for this program. The following Restaurant Management section (page 171) belongs to another program and was not read.
